package usecase

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// This opt-in acceptance test uses a deterministic, repository-owned candidate fixture, while
// both TZ Planner and Practice are the real running services selected by D8_PROOF_*_URL.
func TestNativeRealPracticeStagingLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	mode := os.Getenv("D8_NATIVE_STAGING_PROOF_MODE")
	if mode == "" {
		t.Skip("set D8_NATIVE_STAGING_PROOF_MODE for the real-service staging acceptance proof")
	}
	if mode != "seed" && mode != "unavailable" && mode != "stage" && mode != "replay" && mode != "cleanup" {
		t.Fatalf("unknown D8_NATIVE_STAGING_PROOF_MODE %q", mode)
	}
	proofKey := os.Getenv("D8_NATIVE_STAGING_PROOF_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY")
	if !validUUID(proofKey) {
		t.Fatal("D8_NATIVE_STAGING_PROOF_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY must be a UUID")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 90*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	tzPool := proofPool(t, ctx, os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL"), "DATABASE_URL")
	defer tzPool.Close()
	repository := postgres.JobRepository{Pool: tzPool}

	if mode == "seed" {
		candidate := validCandidate()
		marker := proofMarker(proofKey)
		candidate.PrivateEvaluation.Reference.Files[0].Content += "\n" + marker
		planner := newTestPlanner(repository, &generatorStub{candidate: candidate}, &competencyStub{}, validationStub{passed: true}, &workspaceStub{})
		job, created, err := planner.Plan(ctx, proofKey, validRequest("D8.5 private staging proof "+proofKey))
		if err != nil || job.Status != domain.JobStatusReady || job.Artifact == nil || !job.Artifact.Verification.Passed {
			t.Fatalf("safe fixture did not persist as READY: status=%s created=%v err=%v", job.Status, created, err)
		}
		t.Logf("seeded exact synthetic verified fixture: job=%s status=%s marker=%s", job.ID, job.Status, marker)
		return
	}

	var jobID string
	if err := tzPool.QueryRow(ctx, "SELECT id::text FROM tz_authoring_job WHERE idempotency_key=$1", proofKey).Scan(&jobID); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("resolve exact authoring fixture key: %v", err)
	}
	job, err := repository.Get(ctx, jobID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("load exact authoring fixture: %v", err)
	}
	if mode == "cleanup" {
		cleanupProofFixture(t, ctx, tzPool, jobID)
		return
	}
	if job.Artifact == nil || !strings.Contains(job.Artifact.Candidate.PrivateEvaluation.Reference.Files[0].Content, proofMarker(proofKey)) {
		t.Fatal("authoring fixture does not contain its unique private evaluation marker")
	}

	tzURL := proofURL("D8_PROOF_TZ_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:"+envOr("HTTP_PORT", "18088"))
	practiceURL := proofURL("D8_PROOF_PRACTICE_URL", os.Getenv("PRACTICE_TASK_SERVICE_URL"))
	token := os.Getenv("INTERNAL_API_TOKEN")
	if token == "" || practiceURL == "" {
		t.Fatal("real TZ auth token and Practice URL must be configured by native_config.py")
	}

	if mode == "unavailable" {
		if job.Status != domain.JobStatusReady {
			t.Fatalf("unavailable-path fixture began in %s, want READY", job.Status)
		}
		status, body := postProofJSON(t, ctx, tzURL+"/internal/v1/authoring-jobs/"+jobID+"/stage", token, "", nil)
		if status != http.StatusBadGateway {
			t.Fatalf("Practice-unavailable response status=%d body=%s, want 502", status, body)
		}
		stored, getErr := repository.Get(ctx, jobID)
		if getErr != nil || stored.Status != domain.JobStatusReady || stored.Staging != nil {
			t.Fatalf("failed handoff advanced TZ state: status=%s staging=%v err=%v", stored.Status, stored.Staging, getErr)
		}
		t.Logf("Practice-unavailable failure preserved READY: job=%s", jobID)
		return
	}

	status, body := postProofJSON(t, ctx, tzURL+"/internal/v1/authoring-jobs/"+jobID+"/stage", token, "", nil)
	if status != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("real TZ staging route status=%d body=%s", status, body)
	}
	var projection struct {
		ID      string                   `json:"id"`
		Status  domain.JobStatus         `json:"status"`
		Staging *domain.StagingReceiptV1 `json:"staging"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &projection); err != nil || projection.ID != jobID || projection.Status != domain.JobStatusStaged || projection.Staging == nil {
		t.Fatalf("real TZ staging projection invalid: projection=%+v err=%v", projection, err)
	}
	if projection.Staging.State != "staged" || projection.Staging.AuthoringJobID != jobID || projection.Staging.StagedID == "" {
		t.Fatalf("invalid Practice receipt in TZ projection: %+v", *projection.Staging)
	}

	practicePool := proofPool(t, ctx, os.Getenv("D8_PRACTICE_STAGING_TEST_DATABASE_URL"), "D8_PRACTICE_STAGING_TEST_DATABASE_URL")
	defer practicePool.Close()
	marker := proofMarker(proofKey)
	var state, blueprintJSON, evaluationJSON, verificationJSON, provenanceJSON string
	if err := practicePool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT state, blueprint_json::text, private_evaluation_json::text, verification_json::text, provenance_json::text FROM practice_tz_authoring_staging WHERE authoring_job_id=$1`, jobID).Scan(&state, &blueprintJSON, &evaluationJSON, &verificationJSON, &provenanceJSON); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read exact durable Practice staging row: %v", err)
	}
	var blueprintEvidence map[string]any
	var verificationEvidence map[string]any
	var provenanceEvidence map[string]any
	if json.Unmarshal([]byte(blueprintJSON), &blueprintEvidence) != nil || json.Unmarshal([]byte(verificationJSON), &verificationEvidence) != nil || json.Unmarshal([]byte(provenanceJSON), &provenanceEvidence) != nil {
		t.Fatal("persisted staging evidence is not valid JSON")
	}
	identityEvidence, _ := blueprintEvidence["identity"].(map[string]any)
	generationEvidence, generationOK := provenanceEvidence["generation"].(map[string]any)
	passed, passedOK := verificationEvidence["passed"].(bool)
	if state != "staged" || !strings.Contains(evaluationJSON, marker) || !passedOK || !passed || !generationOK || len(generationEvidence) == 0 || identityEvidence["family_key"] == nil {
		t.Fatalf("staging row lost required private candidate evidence: state=%s", state)
	}

	command := proofStageCommand(jobID, *job.Artifact)
	commandBody, err := json.Marshal(command)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	practiceToken := os.Getenv("LW_PRACTICE_TZ_TOKEN")
	if practiceToken == "" {
		t.Fatal("dedicated Practice TZ token is not configured")
	}
	practiceStatus, practiceBody := postProofJSON(t, ctx, practiceURL+"/internal/authoring/v1/task-revisions/stage", practiceToken, jobID, commandBody)
	var practiceReceipt domain.StagingReceiptV1
	if practiceStatus != http.StatusOK || json.Unmarshal(practiceBody, &practiceReceipt) != nil || practiceReceipt.Created || practiceReceipt.StagedID != projection.Staging.StagedID {
		t.Fatalf("identical direct Practice retry did not return the stable receipt: status=%d body=%s", practiceStatus, practiceBody)
	}
	provePracticeAuthAndConflict(t, ctx, practiceURL, practiceToken, jobID, commandBody, command, job.Artifact.Candidate)
	provePublicIsolation(t, ctx, practiceURL, projection.Staging.StagedID, marker)

	status, retryBody := postProofJSON(t, ctx, tzURL+"/internal/v1/authoring-jobs/"+jobID+"/stage", token, "", nil)
	var retry struct {
		Status  domain.JobStatus         `json:"status"`
		Staging *domain.StagingReceiptV1 `json:"staging"`
	}
	if status != http.StatusOK || json.Unmarshal(retryBody, &retry) != nil || retry.Status != domain.JobStatusStaged || retry.Staging == nil || retry.Staging.StagedID != projection.Staging.StagedID {
		t.Fatalf("TZ durable retry changed staged identity: status=%d body=%s", status, retryBody)
	}
	t.Logf("real-service staging proof passed: job=%s staged_id=%s status=%s mode=%s", jobID, projection.Staging.StagedID, retry.Status, mode)
}

func proofStageCommand(jobID string, artifact domain.AuthoringArtifact) map[string]any {
	return map[string]any{
		"schema": "practice-task-staging-command.v1", "authoring_job_id": jobID,
		"candidate_digest": artifact.CandidateDigest, "contract_digest": artifact.ContractDigest,
		"capabilities_digest": artifact.CapabilitiesDigest, "candidate": artifact.Candidate,
		"verification": artifact.Verification,
	}
}

func provePracticeAuthAndConflict(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, baseURL, tzToken, jobID string, validBody []byte, command map[string]any, candidate domain.AuthoringCandidateV1) {
	t.Helper()
	path := baseURL + "/internal/authoring/v1/task-revisions/stage"
	for name, token := range map[string]string{"missing": "", "wrong": "not-the-TZ-token", "generic": os.Getenv("D8_TEST_GENERIC_TOKEN")} {
		if name == "generic" && token == "" {
			t.Fatal("generic-token rejection proof is missing D8_TEST_GENERIC_TOKEN")
		}
		status, _ := postProofJSON(t, ctx, path, token, jobID, validBody)
		if status != http.StatusForbidden {
			t.Fatalf("Practice %s credential status=%d, want 403", name, status)
		}
	}

	invalid := make(map[string]any, len(command))
	for key, value := range command {
		invalid[key] = value
	}
	invalid["candidate_digest"] = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("f", 64)
	invalidBody, err := json.Marshal(invalid)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	status, _ := postProofJSON(t, ctx, path, tzToken, jobID, invalidBody)
	if status != http.StatusUnprocessableEntity {
		t.Fatalf("invalid candidate status=%d, want 422", status)
	}

	candidate.PrivateEvaluation.Reference.Files[0].Content += "\nconflicting-payload"
	digest, err := candidate.Digest()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	conflict := make(map[string]any, len(command))
	for key, value := range command {
		conflict[key] = value
	}
	conflict["candidate"] = candidate
	conflict["candidate_digest"] = digest
	conflictBody, err := json.Marshal(conflict)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	status, body := postProofJSON(t, ctx, path, tzToken, jobID, conflictBody)
	if status != http.StatusConflict || !bytes.Contains(body, []byte("idempotency_conflict")) {
		t.Fatalf("conflicting retry status=%d body=%s, want explicit 409", status, body)
	}
}

func provePublicIsolation(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, baseURL, stagedID, marker string) {
	t.Helper()
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, baseURL+"/api/v1/practice-tasks", nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000099")
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
	response, err := proofHTTPClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("public student catalog request failed: %v", err)
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 2<<20))
	if err != nil || response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("public student catalog status=%d err=%v", response.StatusCode, err)
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{stagedID, marker, "private_evaluation"} {
		if bytes.Contains(body, []byte(forbidden)) {
			t.Fatalf("private staged candidate leaked through public catalog response (%s)", forbidden)
		}
	}
}

func postProofJSON(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, url, token, idempotencyKey string, body []byte) (int, []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, url, bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	if token != "" {
		request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
	}
	if idempotencyKey != "" {
		request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", idempotencyKey)
	}
	response, err := proofHTTPClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("HTTP proof request failed: %v", err)
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	result, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 10<<20))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read HTTP proof response: %v", err)
	}
	return response.StatusCode, result
}

func cleanupProofFixture(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, tzPool *pgxpool.Pool, jobID string) {
	t.Helper()
	practicePool := proofPool(t, ctx, os.Getenv("D8_PRACTICE_STAGING_TEST_DATABASE_URL"), "D8_PRACTICE_STAGING_TEST_DATABASE_URL")
	defer practicePool.Close()
	practiceResult, err := practicePool.Exec(ctx, "DELETE FROM practice_tz_authoring_staging WHERE authoring_job_id=$1", jobID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("delete exact synthetic Practice staging fixture: %v", err)
	}
	tzResult, err := tzPool.Exec(ctx, "DELETE FROM tz_authoring_job WHERE id=$1", jobID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("delete exact synthetic TZ authoring fixture: %v", err)
	}
	t.Logf("cleaned only synthetic proof rows: practice=%d tz=%d job=%s", practiceResult.RowsAffected(), tzResult.RowsAffected(), jobID)
}

func proofPool(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, databaseURL, variable string) *pgxpool.Pool {
	t.Helper()
	if databaseURL == "" {
		t.Fatalf("%s is not configured", variable)
	}
	pool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, databaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("connect through %s: %v", variable, err)
	}
	return pool
}

func proofURL(variable, fallback string) string {
	if value := os.Getenv(variable); value != "" {
		return strings.TrimRight(value, "/")
	}
	return strings.TrimRight(fallback, "/")
}

func envOr(name, fallback string) string {
	if value := os.Getenv(name); value != "" {
		return value
	}
	return fallback
}

func proofMarker(jobID string) string {
	return "D8_PRIVATE_EVALUATION_" + strings.ReplaceAll(jobID, "-", "")
}

var proofHTTPClient = &http.Client{Timeout: 20 * time.Second}
